physics_findings: The public incompressible periodic flow and constant molecular diffusion define the full unbounded laboratory process. Uniform initial phase is stationary. Unwrapped displacement, all-particle weighting, detector direction, long-time variance/(2t), units and limits uniquely specify the observable.

The source correctly solves Kx=D+A/Ky and Ky=D+B/Kx, where A=(a^2+c^2/4)/2 and B=(b^2+d^2/4)/2. The stable positive root includes the zero-amplitude limits and gives Kx,Ky>=D. It is a complete self-consistent Gaussian phase-sampling approximation; all harmonics enter. Its failure is replacing the actual advected phase law, not an unfinished forward implementation.

One-leg shear has exactly shared nonzero diffusion coefficients. The auxiliary/output noises need not reproduce the full physical tracer path for that coefficient equality. This distinction is explicitly preserved in AUTHOR.

For the physical process, the oracle matrix is the Fourier representation of -D Laplacian-u dot gradient on zero-mean modes, with the full velocity harmonics on the right side. Its D I + D<grad chi_i dot grad chi_j> readout has the correct 1/(2t) normalization and positive enhancement. Uniform ellipticity and incompressibility give the stated coercivity.

The independent reference constructs outgoing spatial jump rates, backward generator and first/second displacement-counting derivatives. Signed marks remain +/-h across periodic wraps, so it measures unwrapped displacement. The anchored corrector and uniform averaging produce the stated symmetric variance tensor. It imports no oracle coefficient or Fourier solver; it is a refined finite-grid representation of the same continuum process.

The full-box rate bound is valid: |u_i|<=8.8 and h<=pi/24 imply every n>=48 rate is at least h^-2(.8-4.4h)>0. The n48 lower bound is13.075. The separate n32 author checks use milder explicitly positive-rate cases; the full-box bound is not claimed for n32.

Diagonal physical diffusivity is justified here: x reflection maps this odd separable flow to full flow reversal while changing Kxy sign; drift reversal exchanges a uniform incompressible generator with its adjoint and preserves the symmetric effective tensor. The oracle/reference still compute both components and cross terms. The source does not win an artificial off-diagonal simplification.
